request: 电脑控制合并到 Aide 主程序的统一接口，系统授权状态在 Aide 设置中查询和申请；macOS 不再展示独立桥接窗口。

acceptance: Aide Settings uses authenticated Aide API to query host computer bridge and platform permission state even when computer control is disabled.
macOS permission requests for Screen Recording and Accessibility are initiated from Aide Settings; status can be refreshed there.
macOS bridge no longer presents an independent user-facing application window or Dock item while retaining stable TCC bundle identity.

requirements.summary: Clarified the desired user-facing integration: one Aide interface for computer control and permission status; hide the macOS helper window while preserving OS-level TCC consent.

design.summary: Route settings status and permission requests through authenticated Aide API endpoints, which reuse the same token-authenticated host bridge transport as the AI tools. Keep macOS helper bundle identity stable for TCC but run it as an accessory/background agent without a standalone window. Report Windows/Linux capability requirements through the same status shape.
